evals.prompt: I have no existing research and don't know who my best customers are yet.
evals.expected_output: Read existing product-marketing context, identify the decision and assumptions, and propose a scoped interview/survey and public-signal plan. Explain who to recruit and what to ask. Do not invent personas or claim interviews have already happened. Choose sample size from the research question and segments.
assertions: Uses existing product-marketing context before asking for missing information
Recognizes a zero-research scenario and forms disconfirmable hypotheses
Routes to the primary-research playbook and includes relevant public sources
Chooses participant segments and sample size for the research question
Produces a plan and recruiting drafts, not fictional findings or completed interviews
Does not send recruitment messages without explicit authorization

evals.prompt: I want to interview and survey my customers to understand product/market fit. How should I run this?
evals.expected_output: Use the primary-research playbook for a PMF interview/survey plan. Propose the disappointment question and follow-ups, recruitment suited to the decision, disconfirming questions, and follow-up probing. Treat any external benchmark or incentive as context to evaluate rather than a universal threshold. Keep outreach as a draft unless already authorized.
assertions: Reads relevant product-marketing context and references/interviews-and-surveys.md
Proposes the PMF disappointment question and benefit/improvement follow-ups
Reports cohort and sample size rather than declaring PMF from a benchmark alone
Explains relevant recruitment segments, referrals, and sample/incentive choices
Uses disconfirming questions and follow-up probing without a mandatory five-question count
Explains the purpose honestly and does not send outreach or promise unapproved incentives
